newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BADMINTON-DANES TO HELP BUILD 800 TOWNSHIP COURTS.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-DANES TO HELP BUILD 800 TOWNSHIP COURTS.

text.p: Up to 800 new badminton clubs are to be established in South Africa's townships as part of a two million rand initiative by Denmark.
The Danish government and Danish Badminton Association will fund the massive boost to the game, the South African Badminton Union announced in Johannesburg on Monday.
"It's the greatest thing that has ever happened to us," union vice-president David Parker told Reuters.
The money will go towards the buying of equipment as well as the marking out of courts in townships over the next two years.
An official of the Danish Badminton Union will be based in South Africa to help oversee the project and assist the union in its development programme to advance the game in black areas.
The project kicks off in March with a tour by the top-ranked Danish national team. They will play the South African national side as well as take part in development clinics in townships.
The initiative was started at the instigation of the South African Embassy in Denmark, one of the world's leading badminton nations.
